title: Welcome to the Beta
author: @aia
body:
Thank you for joining the Prompt Battle beta.

This is a very early build — rules, card gallery, and deck builder are live. Multiplayer is coming next.

**What to focus on this session:**

- Read through Tutorial 1A before your first game
- Note any rules that feel unclear or contradictory
- Pay attention to the Reputation economy — does 20 feel right?
- Try building a custom deck
- Check the Flagged Items doc for specific things I need your eyes on

Use the Feedback button any time. Every note helps.
